_meta.notes: Final-pass mine of §8.14.3 DeepSearchQA Table + §5.x adversarial robustness. 🌍 DeepSearchQA F1 94.2 NEW SOTA (was Kimi K2.6 92.5, +1.7pp). DeepSearchQA Fully Correct 87.0 NEW SOTA (was Kimi 83.0, +4pp). Mythos Preview slightly higher F1 94.4 (-0.2pp Mythos 5 regression but Mythos Preview vs Kimi alread 1.9pp ahead). NEW Gray Swan ART k=100 prompt injection bench (Mythos 5 4.8 ext-thinking, Preview 6.1, Opus 4.8 9.6 — lower better). NEW Coding/Computer/Browser prompt injection benches with both no-safeguards + with-safeguards variants — interesting REGRESSION: Mythos 5 browser-use no-safeguards 29.7% vs Mythos Preview 2.0% vs Opus 4.8 0.5%. Safeguards drop Mythos 5 to 6.5%.
